LanguageData.RK_Backstory_Gypsy.title: Ratkin traveling performer
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_Gypsy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a traveling entertainer who moved from village to village, making a living through song and dance. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to get along with people.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingRefugee.title: Ratkin wandering refugee
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingRefugee.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] was a refugee who lost [PAWN_possessive] home to war and became a wandering refugee. During [PAWN_possessive] travels, they picked up a few tricks along the way.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_CaravanLeader.title: Ratkin caravan merchant
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_CaravanLeader.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up leading a traveling caravan. [PAWN_pronoun] traveled from village to village, trading goods and helping those who wish to settle down find a home.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingMercenary.title: Ratkin hired mercenary
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingMercenary.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] was a wandering mercenary who has moved from battlefield to battlefield. [PAWN_pronoun] learned various skills over their career, they still relish the opportunity for a new employer.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CaravanMerchant.title: Ratkin caravan merchant
LanguageData.Ratkin_CaravanMerchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a merchant who led caravans in the past. After an unfortunate raid took everything, [PAWN_pronoun] decided it was time to begin a new life.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Wanderer.title: Ratkin wanderer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Wanderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was simply a wanderer with no fixed destination. To [PAWN_objective], a life spent tending a garden was little more than a distant dream.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Farmer.title: Ratkin farmer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Farmer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a farmer on the family farm. During their time, [PAWN_pronoun] inherited the family trade from [PAWN_possessive] parents, and [PAWN_possessive] future children are expected to become farmers as well.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Miner.title: Ratkin miner
LanguageData.Ratkin_Miner.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made use of [PAWN_possessive] strengths and became a miner. Digging was easy for [PAWN_objective], but [PAWN_pronoun] longed to escape the cramped, stifling tunnels.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Hunter.title: Ratkin hunter
LanguageData.Ratkin_Hunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted wild animals for a living because unlike most Ratkin, [PAWN_pronoun] had keen eyesight and could spot moving animals from far away.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shepherd.title: Ratkin shepherd
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shepherd.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a ranch with many animals, but after a polluted ship crashed into the barn, that life became nothing more than a memory.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Civil.title: Ratkin citizen
LanguageData.Ratkin_Civil.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a citizen of the Ratkin Kingdom, making a living through odd jobs within the kingdom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Noble.title: Ratkin noble
LanguageData.Ratkin_Noble.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a noble of the Ratkin Kingdom. After being caught in a political incident and forced into exile, [PAWN_pronoun] began wandering in hopes of one day returning.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMerchant.title: Ratkin city merchant
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMerchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a city merchant. Skilled with [PAWN_possessive] hands, [PAWN_pronoun] sold all kinds of goods at the market.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Librarian.title: Ratkin librarian
LanguageData.Ratkin_Librarian.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a librarian who worked the library. [PAWN_pronoun] gained deep scholarly knowledge during their time there, but extensive reading made [PAWN_objective] forget how to dig.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Guardener.title: Ratkin guardener
LanguageData.Ratkin_Guardener.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a guardener of the Ratkin kingdom. During a mission in foreign lands, [PAWN_pronoun] was separated from [PAWN_possessive] group and even now still wishes to go back to their kingdom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Knight.title: Ratkin knight
LanguageData.Ratkin_Knight.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a knight of the Ratkin Kingdom. They were trained to be the pillars that safeguarded the kingdom and [PAWN_pronoun] turned out to be a fierce warrior in their own right.
LanguageData.Ratkin_KnightCommander.title: Ratkin knight commander
LanguageData.Ratkin_KnightCommander.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a chosen knight of the Ratkin Kingdom. By knightly tradition, the commander's successor is selected from knights born on the countryside.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Teacher.title: Ratkin teacher
LanguageData.Ratkin_Teacher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] taught the children in their hometown, but when there were no more children in [PAWN_possessive] rural village, [PAWN_pronoun] set out to find a place that needed [PAWN_possessive] skills.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Blacksmith.title: Ratkin blacksmith
LanguageData.Ratkin_Blacksmith.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a blacksmith who forged weapons and tools. Feeling restrained, [PAWN_pronoun] left [PAWN_possessive] home in search of stronger materials.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Thief.title: Ratkin thief
LanguageData.Ratkin_Thief.description: [PAWN_nameDef] barely scrapped by, forced by circumstance to steal food from others to avoid starving. [PAWN_pronoun] repeatedly found [PAWN_objective]self traveling between towns, leaving when the heat started to catch up.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Ambassador.title: Ratkin ambassador
LanguageData.Ratkin_Ambassador.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a diplomat of the Ratkin Kingdom. A diplomatic dispute costed [PAWN_objective] [PAWN_possessive] job and led to exile from the kingdom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Soldier.title: Ratkin soldier
LanguageData.Ratkin_Soldier.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a soldier in a human city. Trained among humans, [PAWN_pronoun] learned fighting methods unlike those of other Ratkins. After being left for dead during a mission, [PAWN_pronoun] decided it was time to find a new place to call home.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Explorer.title: Ratkin explorer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Explorer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was overflowing with curiosity about the world. [PAWN_pronoun] does not intend to stop until [PAWN_pronoun] has explored the entire planetary system.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Chef.title: Ratkin chef
LanguageData.Ratkin_Chef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a chef with the ambition to cook the best meals in the world. This pushed [PAWN_objective] to set out and find the finest ingredients.
LanguageData.Ratkin_HandMaiden.title: Ratkin handmaiden
LanguageData.Ratkin_HandMaiden.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served a noble as a handmaiden, handling small errands and sometimes acting as the noble's eyes and ears.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shooter.title: Ratkin sharpshooter
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shooter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had unusually good eyesight for a Ratkin. [PAWN_pronoun] used that advantage to volunteer for the military and learned skills that made them into an exceptional marksman.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Doctor.title: Ratkin doctor
LanguageData.Ratkin_Doctor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a royal physician, but after botching a surgery that costed a noble's life, [PAWN_pronoun] was exiled to the frontier. [PAWN_pronoun] traveled far and wide, hoping to prove [PAWN_pronoun] was not at fault and honed [PAWN_possessive] medical skills in the process.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ArmySurgeon.title: Ratkin army surgeon
LanguageData.Ratkin_ArmySurgeon.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a surgeon who saved wounded ratkin in active battlefields. Even if their lives were short, [PAWN_pronoun] still volunteered to pull them back to safety, but [PAWN_pronoun] eventually left after realizing that nothing would change.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ConstructionWorker.title: Ratkin construction worker
LanguageData.Ratkin_ConstructionWorker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a construction worker who mostly built underground tunnels.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Rich.title: Ratkin tycoon
LanguageData.Ratkin_Rich.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had a remarkable talent for making money by deceiving others. Before long, [PAWN_pronoun] was exposed and had no choice but to flee.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Sister.title: Ratkin sister
LanguageData.Ratkin_Sister.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a sister who handled rites and religious duties in Ratkin society. While traveling for a ceremony, [PAWN_pronoun] was attacked and barely escaped with [PAWN_possessive] life.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Butcher.title: Ratkin butcher
LanguageData.Ratkin_Butcher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] slaughtered animals and sold their meat for a living.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMaid.title: Ratkin city maid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMaid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a domestic helper in the city. Humans tended to hire only handsome Ratkins as household staff and [PAWN_pronoun] was one of them.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Idol.title: Ratkin idol
LanguageData.Ratkin_Idol.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in entertainment as an idol. Unfortunately while in transit, the vehicle [PAWN_pronoun] was riding on crashed and [PAWN_pronoun] woke up in an unknown location.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Murderer.title: Ratkin murderer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Murderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Ratkin driven mad. Using [PAWN_possessive] small body to their advantage, they fled the scene before they could be caught. [PAWN_pronoun] came to enjoy murder.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Assistant.title: Ratkin assistant
LanguageData.Ratkin_Assistant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a research assistant, helping humans with studies both large and small. [PAWN_pronoun] learned a few tricks by peeking over their shoulder whenever the opportunity arised.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Scientist.title: Ratkin scientist
LanguageData.Ratkin_Scientist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a scientist who studied alongside human peers. But [PAWN_pronoun] became so absorbed in research that [PAWN_pronoun] grew physically frail and ruined [PAWN_possessive] eyesight.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Engineer.title: Ratkin engineer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Engineer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an engineer who made precision components. [PAWN_pronoun] used [PAWN_possessive] talent to restore an old mechanoid, never realizing it would become the source of disaster.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Agriculturist.title: Ratkin agriculturist
LanguageData.Ratkin_Agriculturist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an agricultural scholar who left the city seeking ways to improve Ratkin farming. [PAWN_pronoun] dreams of the day when they can return to their hometown and develop the agricultural sector there.
LanguageData.Ratkin_RatkinHunter.title: Ratkin slave hunter
LanguageData.Ratkin_RatkinHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a hunter tasked with catching escaped ratkin. One day however, [PAWN_pronoun] felt a sense of clarity when they were sent to hunt down a young ratkin fugitive. [PAWN_pronoun] left with a sense of guilt about [PAWN_possessive] job after the encounter.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Subject.title: Ratkin lab subject
LanguageData.Ratkin_Subject.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a ratkin subjected to countless experiments while in captivity. The experiments done on [PAWN_objective] made them a stronger ratkin and, when an accident occurred that resulted in an open door, [PAWN_pronoun] ran and never looked back.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Vagabond.title: Ratkin vagabond
LanguageData.Ratkin_Vagabond.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived as a wanderer with no destination. [PAWN_possessive] exact past is unknown, but the wisdom [PAWN_pronoun] gained on the road was enough to get by.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Demoman.title: Ratkin demoman
LanguageData.Ratkin_Demoman.description: Unlike other Ratkins, [PAWN_nameDef]'s fanatically obsessed with explosions. [PAWN_pronoun] used this obsession to volunteer for a Ratkin commando unit.
LanguageData.Ratkin_WildChild.title: Ratkin wild born
LanguageData.Ratkin_WildChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the wild without the benefits of civilization. The harsh wilderness made [PAWN_objective] strong, but left them without a proper education.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LandRat.title: Ratkin cave rat
LanguageData.Ratkin_LandRat.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in darkness. Years of cave life made [PAWN_objective] skilled at digging, but when many of [PAWN_possessive] kin went to the surface, [PAWN_pronoun] stayed behind.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CountryKid.title: Ratkin country kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CountryKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s grandparents were farmers, and so were [PAWN_possessive] parents. By family tradition, [PAWN_pronoun] is expected to become a farmer too.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ShepherdBoy.title: Ratkin shepherd boy
LanguageData.Ratkin_ShepherdBoy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among many kinds of livestock on the farm. [PAWN_pronoun] felt a special bond with the farm animals, even calling them [PAWN_possessive] friends.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Orphan.title: Ratkin orphan
LanguageData.Ratkin_Orphan.description: Abandoned at a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] never had parents to guide them. [PAWN_pronoun] had to learn the hard way on how to survive on [PAWN_possessive] own.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Student.title: Ratkin student
LanguageData.Ratkin_Student.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family weren't very wealthy, but not so poor that [PAWN_pronoun] couldn't study. [PAWN_pronoun] was good at academic work, though [PAWN_possessive] marks in physical education were never impressive.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LittleLibrarian.title: Ratkin little librarian
LanguageData.Ratkin_LittleLibrarian.description: With librarians for parents, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with stacks of books. Those books broadened and deepened [PAWN_possessive] education, but also left [PAWN_objective] barely able to see without glasses.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GoldenSpoon.title: Ratkin golden spoon
LanguageData.Ratkin_GoldenSpoon.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a wealthy family that spoonfed them thoughout their childhood. Raised like a precious work of art, [PAWN_pronoun] never learned to do much cooking and was never confronted with violence.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Bastard.title: Ratkin royal bastard
LanguageData.Ratkin_Bastard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the child of a noble and a prostitute. After being found out in a plot to become heir, [PAWN_pronoun] was forced to flee and become a fugitive.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Successor.title: Ratkin heir
LanguageData.Ratkin_Successor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to be heir to a nobility family. When the once-illustrious family began to decline, [PAWN_pronoun] had to leave in order to protect them.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuardenerStudent.title: Ratkin guardener student
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuardenerStudent.description: [PAWN_nameDef] entered training to become a guardener. In Ratkin society only the best may protect the gardens, so [PAWN_pronoun] had to work with relentless dedication.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ChefStudent.title: Ratkin chef student
LanguageData.Ratkin_ChefStudent.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began cooking at a young age because [PAWN_pronoun] loved eating. Food was one of life's great joys for [PAWN_objective], so [PAWN_pronoun] set out in search of even better flavors.
LanguageData.Ratkin_RomanyKid.title: Ratkin drifter kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_RomanyKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived on the road, drifting from place to place. [PAWN_pronoun] was versatile, but a rootless life left little room for [PAWN_objective] to make friends.
LanguageData.Ratkin_OfficerChild.title: Ratkin officer child
LanguageData.Ratkin_OfficerChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born from an officer. The marksmanship and charisma [PAWN_pronoun] learned from [PAWN_possessive] parents at a young age made them a natural-born leader, but their tutelage also made them arrogant.
LanguageData.Ratkin_MerchantKid.title: Ratkin merchant kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_MerchantKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a caravan. By watching [PAWN_possessive] parents trade, [PAWN_pronoun] learned the value of money at a young age.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Kid.title: Ratkin kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_Kid.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was an ordinary child. In an ordinary household, [PAWN_pronoun] learned bits and pieces by watching [PAWN_possessive] parents work.
Without access to higher education, [PAWN_pronoun] never gained specialized knowledge.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ServentChild.title: Ratkin servant child
LanguageData.Ratkin_ServentChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to the child of a servant. By law, [PAWN_pronoun] was destined to become a servant too, but [PAWN_pronoun] fled to change [PAWN_possessive] own fate.
LanguageData.Ratkin_HumanAssistant.title: Ratkin human assistant
LanguageData.Ratkin_HumanAssistant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has helped their master ever since [PAWN_pronoun] was a child, serving as their lab assistant. When [PAWN_possessive] owner died in an accident, [PAWN_pronoun] took the opportunity to obtain their freedom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityKid.title: Ratkin city kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the city. Exposure to urban civilization allowed [PAWN_objective] to understand technology and culture more easily than other Ratkins.
LanguageData.Ratkin_SlaveKid.title: Ratkin slave kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_SlaveKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] does not know how it happened, but [PAWN_pronoun] found themselves bearing a slave brand. After enduring endless menial work, [PAWN_pronoun] managed to escape [PAWN_possessive] captors to freedom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LaboratoryRats.title: Ratkin specimen
LanguageData.Ratkin_LaboratoryRats.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a human laboratory to be used as a genetic modification specimen for an experimental military program. Feeling a deep longing for freedom, [PAWN_pronoun] bided [PAWN_possessive] time before escaping from the lab.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WandererChild.title: wandering child
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WandererChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has lived without a fixed home since childhood. Unable to stay in one place, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to survive while wandering the roads.
LanguageData.Ratkin_PettyTheft.title: Ratkin petty thief
LanguageData.Ratkin_PettyTheft.description: To [PAWN_nameDef], stealing was only viewed as borrowing. [PAWN_possessive] frequent thefts eventually caught up with [PAWN_objective], and while being taken away to be used for slave labor, a raid gave [PAWN_objective] the opportunity to escape.
